Certifications If Any

* U.S financial services experience preferable

* The candidate must be at an advanced to expert level in SAS and SQL. Should also have familiarity with other programming languages such as Python, R or Java. Knowledge of data extraction tools such as Hive or HUE will be useful.

**Desired Skills**

Bachelor’s degree is desired, preferably in a quantitative discipline such as mathematics, statistics, engineering, computer science, finance or business. Post graduate degree is a plus.

Mumbai/ Chennai/ Gift

title: Technical Lead
description:
The Senior AI Engineer will lead the design and implementation of AI-powered applications, intelligent agents, predictive analytics solutions, and scalable backend services. This role requires expertise in Python development, machine learning, enterprise AI platforms, cloud technologies, and API architecture.
  
  
You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to transform business requirements into secure, scalable, and production-ready solutions while ensuring alignment with enterprise governance and compliance standards.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Generative AI & Agent Development
  
  

* Design, develop, and deploy enterprise-grade AI agents, copilots, and conversational applications.
* Implement multi-agent systems, tool-calling workflows, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, and prompt orchestration frameworks.
* Integrate AI solutions with Microsoft 365 technologies, including Teams, SharePoint, Outlook, Power Platform, Copilot Studio, and Microsoft Graph.
* Apply AI-assisted engineering practices to accelerate software delivery while maintaining code quality and security standards.
* Establish governance, monitoring, and evaluation frameworks for AI applications.

Machine Learning & Predictive Analytics
  
  

* Design and deploy predictive machine learning models for classification, regression, forecasting, and anomaly detection use cases.
* Build and maintain data pipelines supporting model development and deployment.
* Manage the end-to-end machine learning lifecycle, including feature engineering, training, validation, deployment, and monitoring.
* Collaborate with data engineering teams to develop scalable data solutions.

Backend Engineering
  
  

* Develop scalable APIs and backend services using Python frameworks such as FastAPI, Flask, or Django.
* Build maintainable, testable, and well-documented applications following modern software development practices.
* Participate in architecture reviews and technical design discussions.
* Support CI/CD implementation and cloud deployment strategies.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related discipline.
* 8+ years of professional software development experience.
* Strong proficiency in Python, including object-oriented programming, asynchronous programming, and API development.
* Experience developing Generative AI applications using modern LLM platforms and agent frameworks.
* Experience implementing RAG architectures and vector database solutions.
* Strong understanding of machine learning concepts and hands-on experience with scikit-learn, pandas, NumPy, and PyTorch or TensorFlow.
* Experience building REST APIs and production-ready data pipelines.
* Experience with Microsoft Azure and Microsoft 365 integration technologies.
* Knowledge of software architecture, security, scalability, and enterprise integration patterns.
* Experience using Git-based development workflows and AI-assisted coding tools.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Java and Spring Boot.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Familiarity with MLOps platforms such as MLflow, Kubeflow, or Azure Machine Learning.
* Experience building enterprise copilots and AI assistants.
* Knowledge of AI evaluation frameworks, guardrails, observability, and responsible AI practices.

title: Solutions Manager
description:
**ABOUT CULTUREMONKEY**

CultureMonkey is an AI-powered employee engagement and experience platform helping organizations build exceptional workplaces through continuous listening, people analytics, and action planning. Trusted across 100+ countries and rated 4.7/5 on G2.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

* We are looking for a Solutions Manager who can become the product brain, implementation partner, and trusted advisor for our customers.
* This role sits at the intersection of Product, Customer Success, People Science, and Customer Outcomes.
* Our Customer Success Managers own the relationship and commercial health of the account.
* You will own the actual survey experience. You will make sure every survey is set up correctly, launched smoothly, understood clearly, and used meaningfully after the results come in.
* This is not a support role. This is a consulting role.
* You will guide HR leaders, people teams, sub-admins, and internal champions through the full journey... from first setup to final insights to action planning.
* You should enjoy going deep into the product, asking sharp questions, solving messy implementation problems, and helping customers get real value from CultureMonkey.

**WHAT YOU'LL OWN**

* Own the full survey lifecycle for your accounts, from setup to launch to reporting.
* Understand the customer’s people goals and translate them into the right survey design, platform configuration, and launch plan.
* Run onboarding sessions, product trainings, and walkthroughs for HR teams, sub-admins, managers, and employee champions.
* Guide customers on survey best practices, participation strategy, question design, anonymity, reporting, and action planning.
* Handle technical setup like employee data uploads, CSV and Excel files, custom configurations, integrations, access rules, and reporting requirements.
* Work with the People Science team to deliver reports and insights that match the customer’s real context.
* Partner closely with CSMs to flag adoption risks, unblock customers, spot expansion opportunities, and keep the account journey smooth.
* Raise and track Jira tickets for bugs, backend tasks, feature requests, and product gaps.
* Become the internal voice of the customer for Product and Engineering.
* Run roadmap and product update conversations with customers so they always know what is possible and what is coming next.
* Most importantly, make sure the customer does not just “run a survey”...
* Make sure they actually understand what their people are saying.

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

* 3+ years of experience in Customer Success, Technical Account Management, Solutions Engineering, Implementation, Customer Service, or a similar customer-facing SaaS role.
* Someone who can learn a product deeply and explain it simply.
* Someone who is comfortable working with HRIS data, employee data files, CSVs, Excel, user attributes, reporting structures, and basic integration concepts.
* A clear communicator who can run a training session with an HR team and also explain technical details to an IT stakeholder.
* Strong project management habits. You follow up, track open items, document clearly, and keep multiple accounts moving without being chased.
* A consulting mindset. You ask good questions before giving answers. You can push back kindly when a customer’s approach may not help them.
* A strong eye for detail. Survey setup, data mapping, anonymity rules, access control, and reporting logic need precision.
* A collaborative nature. You will work closely with CSMs, People Science, Product, and Engineering.Comfort with flexible shifts that overlap with US time zones, because our customers are spread across geographies.

**THE KIND OF PERSON WE ARE HOPING TO MEET**

* Someone who can bring calm to complexity.
* Someone who can sit with an HR leader, understand their culture problem, and translate it into a clean survey journey.
* Someone who can tell a customer, “Here's a better way to do this,” with both confidence and kindness.
* Someone who wants to build, not just maintain.
* Someone who believes customer success is not only about renewals...
* It is about making customers feel, “these people really understand us.”

If that sounds like you, we would love to meet you.

description:
**Job Title: Senior Data Governance Engineer**

  
  

**Location:**
Chennai, India

  
  

**Job Type:**
Full-time

Technology / Data

  
  

**Reports to:**
Raja Krishnamoorthi

  
  

**About Pearson**

  
  

At Pearson, our purpose is simple: to help people realize the life they imagine through learning. We are building the world’s leading learning company by providing digital content, assessments, and services that support learners at every stage.

  
  

As part of Pearson’s Chief Technology Office (OCTO), the Keystone Data Governance team is responsible for enabling trusted, high-quality, and compliant data across the enterprise. We are transforming how data is governed by embedding automation, scalability, and modern data engineering practices into our governance model.

  
  

**The Role**

  
  

We are seeking highly motivated
**Data Governance Engineers**
to join our Chennai-based team. This is a hands-on engineering role focused on building and scaling automated Data Governance capabilities across Pearson’s data ecosystem.

  
  

This role is primarily an
**engineering-focused position (approximately 70–80% hands-on engineering, 20–30% governance-related work)**
. The expectation is that strong data engineers will apply their skills to governance-focused use cases, while developing deeper expertise in data governance, metadata, and compliance domains over time.

  
  

You will work closely with global Data Governance leadership, data engineering teams, and external partners to design and implement solutions that operationalize governance at scale. This role is critical to reducing manual effort for business stakeholders while improving data quality, compliance, and discoverability.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**

  
  

**Governance Engineering & Automation**

  

  
* Design and build automation solutions that operationalize Data Governance processes and reduce manual effort for Data Stewards.
  
  
* Translate governance policies into scalable, technical implementations embedded within data platforms (with guidance from senior team members as needed).
  
  
* Together with US-based Data Governance team, develop reusable frameworks and patterns that enable consistent governance adoption across business units.
  

  

**Collibra Platform & Integration**

  

  
* Configure, extend, and support the Collibra Data Governance platform, including workflows and API-based integrations.
  
  
* Integrate Collibra with enterprise data platforms to enable automated metadata ingestion, lineage, and governance workflows.
  
  
* Support enterprise data catalog, business glossary, and lineage capabilities.
  

  

**Metadata & Data Catalog Management**

  

  
* Support the build-out of integrations with data sources (e.g., RDBMS, data warehouses, data lakes, SaaS systems, PaaS systems) to support catalog ingestion.
  
  
* Enable automated data discovery, classification, and enrichment to improve usability and trust.
  
  
* Ensure metadata accuracy, completeness, and scalability across platforms.
  

  

**Data Quality Engineering**

  

  
* Design and implement data quality rules, monitoring solutions, and validation pipelines as needed to support OCTO team and Pearson business units.
  
  
* Build and manage data quality jobs to support profiling, validation, and issue detection.
  
  
* Collaborate with Data Stewards to define quality standards and remediation workflows.
  

  

**Data Compliance, Security & Privacy**

  

  
* Implement governance controls for data classification, access management, and privacy compliance.
  
  
* Integrate governance workflows with enterprise security and compliance tooling.
  
  
* Support initiatives related to regulatory and policy compliance requirements.
  

  

**Data Engineering & Integration**

  

  
* Develop and maintain data pipelines, APIs, and integration services supporting governance use cases.
  
  
* Integrate data across platforms using ETL/ELT processes and modern data engineering practices.
  
  
* Ensure pipelines align with governance standards for quality, lineage, and security.
  

  

**Collaboration & Delivery**

  

  
* Partner with global stakeholders and Data Governance leadership to deliver prioritized backlog items. Participate in stand-up meetings with US-based team, accept assignments from US team leads.
  
  
* Work closely with engineering teams and external partners (e.g., Deloitte) to industrialize governance solutions.
  
  
* Contribute to documentation, standards, and best practices for governance engineering.
  

  

**Qualifications**

  
  

**Required (Core Engineering Skills)**

  

  
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Engineering, or related technical field.
  
  
* 3–6+ years of experience in data engineering, data platform engineering, or related roles.
  
  
* Strong programming and data engineering experience (e.g., Python, SQL).
  
  
* Hands-on experience with APIs and system integrations (REST, microservices).
  
  
* Familiarity with modern cloud-based data platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, Snowflake, Databricks).
  

  

**Preferred (Data Governance & Domain Experience – can be developed on the job)**

  

  
* Understanding of data governance concepts including metadata, lineage, and data quality.
  
  
* Experience with data governance tools, preferably Collibra.
  
  
* Experience implementing data catalog, lineage, or metadata management solutions.
  
  
* Exposure to data quality frameworks and monitoring tools.
  
  
* Knowledge of data privacy, security, and compliance principles (e.g., PII, access controls).
  
  
* Experience designing and implementing data pipelines or integrating data from multiple sources.
  
  
* Experience working in global, cross-functional teams.
  

  

**Skills & Attributes**

  

  
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
  
  
* Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
  
  
* Excellent collaboration and communication skills across technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  
  
* Self-starter with a focus on delivering scalable, high-quality solutions.
  
  
* Interest in developing expertise in Data Governance and enterprise data management practices.
  
  
* Commitment to continuous learning and improvement.
  

  

**What We Offer**

  

  
* Opportunity to contribute to a global, enterprise-wide Data Governance transformation.
  
  
* Exposure to modern data platforms, tools, and engineering practices.
  
  
* Collaborative, inclusive, and growth-oriented work environment.
  
  
* Competitive compensation and benefits aligned with local market standards.

Verizon is seeking a highly technical, hands-on Principal Security Engineer to join our Data as a Service (DaaS) & Analytics team. This is an execution-focused, "hands-on with code" position. You will architect and build modern data products, leveraging the Google Cloud Platform (GCP) ecosystem to design scalable ETL/ELT pipelines and serverless application architectures.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing...**

* Architecting and optimizing large-scale security data repositories within Google BigQuery, ensuring efficient partitioning, clustering, and storage tiering to support multi-terabyte analytical queries.
* Designing and implementing robust, low-latency data pipelines using GCP Dataflow services (Apache Beam) to ingest, transform, and aggregate batch and streaming data from disparate security sources into centralized data platforms.

* Developing and maintaining a standardized semantic layer using LookML (Looker Modeling Language) to ensure data consistency, security access controls, and reusability across all security domains.
* Building comprehensive business cases and data models surrounding Enterprise Security Data Analysis and Reporting to drive long-term security investments.

**What We’re Looking For...**

* Proven experience architecting and developing solutions within Google Cloud Platform, specifically leveraging containerized deployments via Cloud Run and serverless computing via Cloud Functions.
* Deep technical mastery of Google BigQuery architecture, including nested/repeated fields, materialized views, and BigQuery Omni or ML capabilities.
* Hands-on experience building streaming and batch data processing pipelines using GCP Dataflow services.
* Advanced proficiency in writing complex, optimized SQL queries, with specific hands-on administration and optimization experience using GCP Cloud SQL utilizing the PostgreSQL engine.
* Strong hands-on coding expertise in Python to perform advanced data analysis, data mining, DevSecOps automation, and pipeline orchestration.
* Familiarity with deploying AI-driven automation workflows to improve data pipeline resilience.
* Experience utilizing visualization platforms (e.g., Tableau, Looker, Thoughtspot) to build data-driven stories tailored for business users at all levels.
* Experience embedding Looker visualizations directly into serverless applications or enterprise API frameworks is highly desirable.

**You’ll Need To Have**

* Bachelor degree in Computer Science/Information Systems or six or more years of work experience.
* Eight or more years of professional experience in data analytics, business analysis or comparable analytics position.
* Advanced proficiency in Python and writing complex, optimized SQL queries, with specific hands-on administration and optimization experience using GCP Cloud SQL utilizing the PostgreSQL engine.
* Ability to write SQL against a relational database in order to analyze and test data.
* Experience with modern DataOps/DevSecOps orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow, dbt, CI/CD pipelines) applied directly to data engineering.
* Working knowledge on Threat, Risk and Vulnerability Management is an added advantage.
* Knowledge of securing cloud data delivery layers (OAuth, OIDC, API Gateways) and enforcing data privacy/governance standards.
* Cloud Certifications

**Even better if you have one or more of the following:**

* Experience in technology leadership, architecture, and Agile methodologies.

title: Quality Specialist - Tamil, AGI Data Services - Quality
description:
**Description**
Quality Specialists play a vital role in establishing and maintaining comprehensive quality frameworks across our operations. Their primary responsibility begins with developing robust quality strategies in collaboration with customers and CPMs, encompassing metrics, audit approaches, and specific targets for each workflow. When quality issues arise, these specialists create prescriptive actions, examining data patterns to formulate effective solutions. They maintain a continuous improvement cycle by managing a critical feedback loop between operations and customers, drawing insights from multiple sources including quality auditors, side-by-side observations, and metric analysis. Through regular side-by-side sessions, they identify opportunities for workflow enhancement and quality improvements. The specialists serve as key escalation points for customer concerns, providing strategic recommendations based on their deep understanding of processes. They consistently evaluate quality tools, suggesting refinements to enhance effectiveness, while simultaneously maintaining and updating process documentation to ensure standardization and clarity across all workflows. This comprehensive approach ensures quality remains at the forefront of our operational excellence.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Define and implement quality metrics for established workflows
* Create prescriptive actions for quality issues
* Partner with customers, operations and internal support teams to optimize workflow quality
* Conduct side-by-sides to identify opportunities for workflow enhancement and quality improvements
* Analyze data trends and develop solutions
* Monitor quality performance and coach operations teams
* Create and maintain quality metrics reports
* Handle customer escalations and recommendations
* Evaluate and suggest improvements for quality tools
* Support process documentation and implementation

A day in the life
  
  
Your day starts by checking quality dashboards for your assigned workflows — reviewing audit scores, appeal rates, SLA status, and any overnight escalations. You will spend approximately 30% of your time on analysis: reviewing data trends, investigating root causes of quality dips, and creating prescriptive actions for operations teams.
  
  
Another 30% goes to stakeholder communication: leading weekly customer meetings, preparing quality reports, and handling escalations. The remaining time is split between process work (updating SOPs, refining audit rubrics, conducting side-by-sides) and calibration activities (aligning audit standards with Senior Quality Auditors and operations teams).
  
  
You are measured on: SLA metrics (appeals and batch completion), customer satisfaction, quality improvement trends for your workflows, and documentation quality.
  
  
**About The Team**
The Quality Operations team within FAI Data Services ensures that labeled training data meets accuracy and consistency standards before it is used to train Amazon's AI models. Quality Specialists own the quality strategy for assigned workflows, bridging the gap between operations execution and customer expectations.

description:
****Career Area:****

****Job Description:****
**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**
When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.
  
  
Role Definition
  
  
Caterpillar’s Autonomy and Automation Group is building the autonomous planning platform that moves machines and manipulates terrain across construction sites.
  
  
As a Path Planning Engineer, you will design the navigation and terrain planning that lets autonomous machines drive, dig, and dump safely and efficiently — from stationary digging to high-speed machine navigation. This is an ideal opportunity for someone with experience in developing path planning algorithms, perception techniques and implementing production quality software in C++.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Develop navigation planning — route generation, path planning over drivable terrain, and obstacle avoidance
* Build motion planning that issues control commands to accurately track planned paths
* Design terrain planning that decides where machines engage terrain — dig, dump, and push
* Deliver long-horizon planning for both onboard and offboard execution
* Create reusable planning libraries and common data objects such as path geometry and zones
* Develop search and optimization algorithms and motion & terrain interaction prediction models
* Develop production quality code and own your algorithms from design to production
* Run simulation for path planning algorithm development and test various scenarios
* Test code on construction equipment.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's or Master's in Robotics, Computer Science, or a related engineering field
* Strong foundation in motion and path planning, including search and sampling-based methods such as A\*, RRT, and graph search
* Proficiency in C++ and/or Python for real-time robotics software
* Experience with autonomous ground vehicles, mobile robots, or off-road navigation
* Working knowledge of kinematics, dynamics, and control for path tracking
* Track record building modular, reusable software libraries with clean interfaces

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with off-highway or heavy equipment such as excavators, loaders, and trucks
* Familiarity with terrain modeling and machine-terrain interaction prediction
* Knowledge of perception, localization, and mapping (SLAM)
* Exposure to ROS, simulation, and field testing of autonomy

Be Part of What’s Next in Autonomous Construction Sites
  
  
Construction autonomy is one of the most complex challenges in applied AI, and at Caterpillar, advancements in physical AI, simulation, sensing, and edge computing are turning things that once felt impossible—intelligent machines operating in dynamic jobsites—into reality.
  
  
Our connected ecosystem brings together massive volumes [BH1.1][LR1.2]of high-quality data to create a foundation where engineers like you can build and deploy against.
  
  
If this work motivates you, we invite you to join our team. In these roles, you’ll work at the intersection of the physical and digital worlds. You’ll help design and deliver intelligent systems that enable machines to perceive their environment, make informed decisions, and support safer, more productive operations.
  
  
Apply today to build the new era of construction autonomy at Caterpillar.

title: Associate Director, Third Party Intelligence & Investigations
description:
**Job Summary**
Client & Third Party Security (CTPS) is a specialist team within the Bank’s Group Threat Management (GTM) function, forming part of Information & Cyber Security (ICS) function. The team plays a critical role in delivering the Group’s ICS Strategy by helping build a comprehensive, threat-focused understanding of its external ecosystem, including third party vendors, key partners, and clients. CTPS helps protect the Bank by managing third-party cyber risk end-to-end through delivery of Third Party Security Assessments, contractual control oversight, third party continuous monitoring, detection, analysis and investigation of third party incidents, and targeted remediation of third party security observations. As the threat landscape continues to evolve, CTPS is going through an exciting transformation to become more threat-led, risk-focused and efficient — strengthening supply chain security capabilities and improving detection and remediation of interconnected third-party risks.
  
  
The Associate Director, Third Party Intelligence & Incident Investigations will be part of a specialist team responsible for the proactive detection, analysis and investigation of cyber security incidents impacting the Bank’s third party ecosystem. Sitting within CTPS, this role will play a critical part in strengthening the Bank’s ability to identify emerging third party threats, assess potential exposure, coordinate response activity and clearly articulate risk to senior stakeholders.
  
  
The successful candidate will bring deep expertise across a broad range of cyber security domains including cyber threat intelligence, forensic investigations, incident response and third party security risk management. They will be responsible for supporting investigations into third party incidents and ensuring findings are translated into clear business, operational, client and regulatory risk insights. The role will require strong judgement in high-pressure situations, including determining the potential impact of incidents on Bank data, services, systems, clients and critical third party dependencies.
  
  
This role will also be responsible for engaging directly with senior internal and external stakeholders, including CISOs, CIOs and senior representatives of breached or impacted third parties. The role holder must be able to communicate clearly, challenge effectively, obtain meaningful assurance from third parties and brief complex technical and investigative findings in a clear, concise and business-relevant manner.
  
  
As CTPS continues to strengthen its threat-led and intelligence-enabled approach to third party security risk management, this role will be central to ensuring the Bank remains responsive to a fast-moving external threat landscape.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategy**

* Support the ongoing maturity of CTPS’ third party incident investigations and intelligence programme, ensuring alignment with the wider ICS strategy and the Bank’s approach to managing third party cyber security risk.
* Support the evolution of third party incident detection and investigation capabilities to ensure the Bank remains responsive to a fast-moving, increasingly complex and supply-chain-focused external threat landscape.
* Identify and implement opportunities to enhance the Bank’s overall security posture through new detection capabilities, improved intelligence workflows, enhanced investigation standards and broader programme improvements.

**Business**

* Maintain awareness and understanding of the Group’s business strategy, operating model and third party ecosystem.
* Facilitate business continuity by proactively identifying, assessing and helping mitigate cyber threats targeting the Bank’s clients, third party suppliers and wider supply chain.
* Lead engagements with Contract Managers when investigating third party compromises, ensuring business stakeholders understand potential impact, required actions and escalation pathways.
* Translate complex cyber threat intelligence and investigation findings into clear business, operational and regulatory impact assessments.

**Processes**

* Responsible for operating third party incident detection, triage, investigation, impact assessment and intelligence reporting processes.
* Ensure suspected third party incidents are recorded, validated, investigated, classified and escalated in line with CTPS operating procedures and relevant incident management requirements.
* Maintain rules, alerts and workflows to enhance discovery of relevant intelligence across threat intelligence platforms, monitoring tools, dark web sources, ransomware leak sites and other relevant intelligence sources.
* Pivot on relevant Indicators of Compromise, including domains, IP addresses, infrastructure, threat actor identifiers and other artefacts, to investigate associated threats, actors, infrastructure and potential Bank exposure.
* Adopt consistent investigation standards, evidence requirements, quality assurance expectations and documentation practices.
* Ensure lessons learned from investigations are fed back into relevant control domains, including threat detection, continuous monitoring, third party reassessments, control uplift and executive reporting.

**Risk Management**

* Identify, assess, monitor and support mitigation of cyber risks arising from incidents impacting the Bank’s third party suppliers, clients and broader third party ecosystem.
* Ensure timely escalation of material third party incidents, suspected compromises, control weaknesses and emerging threat trends through appropriate CTPS, ICS and Group risk channels.
* Provide risk-based recommendations to support containment, assurance requests, remediation actions, reassessment triggers, continuous monitoring prioritisation and potential disconnection decisioning.
* Support responsibilities under the Group’s Risk Management Framework by ensuring third party incident risks are identified, assessed, documented, escalated and monitored in a controlled and consistent manner.
* Provide effective challenge where third party responses, assurance evidence, remediation plans or business risk decisions do not sufficiently address the underlying cyber risk exposure.

**Governance**

* Ensure the effectiveness of third party incident detection, investigation, reporting and response arrangements, and suggest improvements where required.
* Ensure that outputs from third party incident investigations are aligned to CTPS governance requirements, ICS risk appetite, incident management expectations and relevant regulatory considerations.

**Regulatory & Business Conduct**

* Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
* Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
* Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

**Key stakeholders**

* Head, Client & Third-Party Security
* Director, Third Party Intelligence & Investigations
* Global Head, Group Threat Management
* Cyber Intelligence Centre
* Threat Assessment & Countermeasures
* Market, Business and Function CISOs
* Technology & Operations Third Party Risk Management Utility team
* Supply Chain Management
* Group Threat Management 1st Line Risk & Control team
* Operational, Technology & Cyber Risk team

**Other Responsibilities**

* Embed Here for good and Group’s brand and values in the CTPS team

**Skills And Experience**

* Effective communications (written and verbal)
* Incident management
* Cyber threat intelligence
* Third party security risk
* Forensic investigations
* Stakeholder engagement

**Qualifications**

* Languages: English (Fluent) Is Essential

**About Standard Chartered**
We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.
  
  
Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.
  
  
**Together We**

* Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
* Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
* Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

**What We Offer**
**In line with our Fair Pay Charter,**
we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
  
  

* Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
* Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
* Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
* Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
* A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
* Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

* Explains the basic decision process associated with specific statistics.

**Analytical Thinking:**
Knowledge of techniques and tools that promote effective analysis; ability to determine the root cause of organizational problems and create alternative solutions that resolve these problems.
  
  
**Level Working Knowledge:**

* Approaches a situation or problem by defining the problem or issue and determining its significance.

Knowledge of principles, technologies and algorithms of machine learning; ability to develop, implement and deliver related systems, products and services.
  
  
**Level Working Knowledge:**

Knowledge of data management systems; ability to use, support and access facilities for searching, extracting and formatting data for further use.
  
  
**Level Working Knowledge:**

title: Data Scientist
description:
**Job Title:**
Data Scientist

**Experience:**
3 to 6 years of relevant data science experience

**About the Job:**

We are looking for Data Scientists who can independently own a modelling workstream and deliver practical improvements to Tonik's lending decisions. Depending on allocation, you will work on cash or installment-loan underwriting, behavioural and offer scores, collections, payroll-backed lending, fraud, offer propensity or income prediction.

You will develop and validate models, investigate performance changes and work with MLE to bring approved models into production. The team is moving toward risk-based refreshes, generally every three to six months for established scorecards, supported by timely monitoring and stronger development discipline.

**Job Responsibilities:**

* Own assigned modelling workstreams from business problem definition and data preparation through feature engineering, model development, validation and production handover. Agree the target, population, success measures and delivery plan with stakeholders.

* Build features from application, demographic, bureau, device, event, transaction, repayment and alternative data. Use Python and SQL to create reproducible datasets and verify joins, missing values, timestamps and customer or loan identifiers.

* Develop and compare scorecards and machine learning models using appropriate statistical and gradient boosting methods. Evaluate component scores, stacked models and segment-specific challengers against credible baselines.

* Design temporal and out-of-time validation, prevent target leakage, and ensure repayment outcomes have matured. Identify distortions caused by restructuring, account freezes, approval policy changes or changing collection strategies.

* Evaluate discrimination, calibration, stability and segment performance using Gini, KS, PSI, CSI and relevant business measures. For the assigned use case, relate model performance to credit losses, recoveries, attrition, offer uptake or prediction error.

* Investigate deterioration and recommend an evidence-based response, including correcting data defects, recalibrating, retraining or redeveloping a model. Explain the effects of changing customer populations and business policies.

* Execute planned refreshes and respond to priority risk issues. Maintain model documentation, feature specifications, validation results and reproducible experiments so the work can be reviewed and repeated.

* Partner with MLE on feature and inference contracts, test cases and pre-release score reconciliation. Support user acceptance testing and post-release checks for real-time underwriting and batch scoring workflows.

* Define monitoring requirements with the DAnR dashboard developer and Risk teams, including cohort definitions, maturity rules, thresholds and segment views. Work with the Data Program Manager on vendor data issues and new-source backtests.

* Participate in code and model reviews, seek technical challenge from Lead Data Scientists, and communicate progress, blockers and findings proactively across Chennai, Manila and Singapore.

* Adhere to model-governance and regulatory documentation standards for every model you build or refresh.

**Required Experience and Qualifications:**

* 3 to 6 years of hands-on data science experience, including practical experience developing credit risk or lending models in a bank, fintech, NBFC or a business delivering lending analytics.

* A bachelor's or master's degree in statistics, mathematics, computer science, data science, engineering or a related quantitative discipline.

* Strong Python and SQL skills, with experience in pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn and at least one gradient boosting library such as XGBoost or LightGBM.

* Sound understanding of classification, probability estimation, feature selection, class imbalance, calibration and temporal validation. Ability to interpret scorecard performance and stability metrics correctly.

* Experience working with large datasets, developing reproducible analytical code, and collaborating with engineers to put models into production. Working knowledge of Git and code review practices.

* Ability to manage an individual workstream, document assumptions and limitations, and explain analytical findings clearly to Risk and business stakeholders.

**Preferred Experience and Qualifications:**

* Experience with behavioural scores, collections, payroll attrition, out-of-pocket repayment risk, offer propensity, fraud or income estimation.

* Experience with alternative data, stacked scorecards, segmentation, survival analysis or model explainability techniques such as SHAP.

* Experience with GCP and Big Query, cloud analytical platforms, experiment tracking and production monitoring.

* Exposure to frequent model refreshes and modelling in populations affected by changing economic conditions or approval policies.

**What Success Looks Like:**

* Assigned models and refreshes are delivered with sound validation, reproducible code and clear handover documentation.

* Performance deterioration is investigated promptly, with recommendations that distinguish model issues from data or policy effects.

* Production scores reconcile with approved model outputs, and monitoring definitions are agreed before release.

**Who are we looking for?**

We value teamwork, honesty, reliability, practical problem-solving and a sense of humour. You take ownership of your work, communicate early when something is wrong, and challenge assumptions respectfully. You are comfortable collaborating across locations and improving how the team works.

* Willingness to go the extra mile for success.

* Energetic and lively, and street smart.

* As our approach to banking is far from ordinary, we are looking for an innovative and creative individual to join our team.

* Above all, a great team player and proactive communicator. This is a table-stake criterion.

**About Tonik:**

We are a transformative digital bank with a mission to revolutionize the way money works. We create better financial products for the world by encouraging inclusivity through simplifying processes, reducing costs, improving transparency, and embracing flexibility to empower more people with unique financial needs. All these are on the most secure mobile banking platform. To enable this, innovation is woven into the DNA of our company. We do not just search for the best talent, but for people who seek to challenge the status quo and are passionate about transforming the impossible into reality.

Tonik (www.tonikbank.com) is the first digital-only neo bank in the Philippines, providing loan, deposit, payment, and card products to consumers on a highly secure digital banking platform. The neo bank operates based on the first private digital bank license issued by the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas. Tonik is led by a team of retail finance veterans who have previously built and scaled multiple retail banks and fintechs across the global emerging markets. It is backed by top international venture capital funds. Tonik operates out of hubs in Singapore (HQ), Manila, Chennai, and Kyiv.

Our Data team works with Risk, Product, Technology and business teams to improve lending decisions and customer outcomes through reliable data, analytics and machine learning.

description:

Can you picture yourself setting enterprise-wide Data and AI strategy while building reusable autonomous frameworks and GenAI capabilities that scale with confidence?
  
  
In this role, you will lead how we embed intelligence into the digital backbone of drug development. You will develop long-term platform funding priorities, capability roadmaps, and technology choices. Then you will translate strategy into solutions that make complex enterprise workflows simpler, safer, and faster for our scientists and product teams.

**Accountabilities**

* Shape and evolve the long-term Data and AI strategy for drug development, including platform investments, capability roadmaps, technology choices and alignment with enterprise architecture.
* Partner with AI science teams to design reusable agentic patterns, GenAI components and scalable solutions that streamline sophisticated enterprise workflows and accelerate delivery.
* Influence enterprise architecture decisions and lead strategic vendor evaluations, pilots and ecosystem partnerships to bring the best technologies into the enterprise.
* Lead multi-functional engineering teams, driving end-to-end delivery from prototype to robust, compliant production systems.
* Define, govern and promote engineering standards, guidelines and reusable design patterns; produce and review detailed technical designs across data models, APIs, integrations, security, deployment, error handling, performance, monitoring, testing and support.
* Promote strong data integrity and governance, including clear ownership, quality management, metadata, lineage, audit trails, master and reference data, and standardized terminology.
* Establish and maintain AI and ML governance controls, covering risk assessment, proper use, human oversight, explainability, model approval, versioning, performance monitoring, change control and retirement.
* Implement production-grade controls for GenAI and retrieval-augmented generation solutions to deliver reliable, traceable and secure outputs based on trusted information, including prompt and model management, response quality testing, source referencing, access controls and mitigations for prompt attacks and data leakage.
* Define and operate comprehensive evaluation and monitoring frameworks that track accuracy, reliability, security, response quality, business relevance, degradation, latency, cost and operational stability.
* Establish API-based and event-driven integration standards, including data formats, contracts, versioning, interoperability and integration with legacy and regulated systems.
* Improve value from enterprise data platforms and guide the implementation of DevOps, DataOps and MLOps practices to deliver resilient, automated, auditable pipelines across data, ML and AI.
* Ensure data solutions adhere to FAIR principles—findable, accessible, interoperable and reusable—and support end-to-end machine learning and AI workflows.
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement, experimentation, collaboration, and innovation across engineering and AI teams, encouraging thoughtful use of AI and digital tools in day-to-day work.

* Track record of leading end-to-end delivery of AI-native products within a controlled or enterprise environment.
* Demonstrable ability translating research advances in GenAI or agent-based systems into scalable industrial solutions.
* Deep knowledge of modern cloud and data architecture patterns: microservices, serverless, etc.
* Hands-on experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), SQL/NoSQL databases, CI/CD, and infrastructure-as-code.
* Fluency in Python, with a good understanding of secure software engineering practices.
* Experience mentoring engineers and leading high-performing teams.
* Comfortable influencing senior partners and shaping technology strategy across functions.

**Desirable Skills/Experience**

* Pharma industry experience, particularly in R&D or Late-Stage Development.
* AI or Gen AI technical certifications or equivalent.
* AWS Cloud Certification or equivalent.

You are not just deploying a tool; you are embedding autonomous, intent-driven AI workflows into the client’s product ecosystem. This role requires a hands-on builder, deep product architect, and first-principles thinker who can gain trust with client developers and justify product ROI to executive stakeholders.
  
  
**Requirements**
**Job Responsibilities**
**Domain-Specific AI Integration**
Architect Intent-Driven Workflows: Design and deploy agentic AI workflows tailored to complex financial domain logic, ensuring systems can reliably process high-stakes data (e.g., automated credit underwriting analysis, regulatory compliance checking, or algorithmic fraud intent mapping).
  
  
Context-Aware RAG Pipelines: Build and optimize domain-specific Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and vector database architectures that ingest massive, disparate financial data sources (e.g., SEC filings, transaction ledgers, legacy ERP schemas) to feed localized AI agents.
  
  
Bridge Legacy Core Systems: Design secure abstraction layers and Model Context Protocol (MCP) implementations that allow AI systems to interact seamlessly with legacy core-banking systems, monolithic financial ledgers, and rigid enterprise APIs.
  
  
**Product Delivery & SDLC Acceleration**
Accelerate Product Feature Delivery: Partner directly with the client’s product and engineering leadership to replace traditional, bottlenecked sprint cycles with autonomous delivery loops that generate domain-compliant code, comprehensive unit tests, and validation artifacts.
  
  
Establish Guardrails & AI Governance: Implement deterministic controls, “human-in-the-loop” verification, and automated compliance checks within the AI pipeline to meet strict financial sector regulatory standards (e.g., SEC, GDPR, SOC2).
  
  
Measure Engineering Velocity: Define, track, and report on hard product metrics resulting from AI implementation, such as reduction in feature-to-production cycle time, code review velocity, and coverage of automated edge-case test generation.
  
  
**Forward-Deployed Customer Engagement**
Embedded Engineering Leadership: Embed directly within client engineering teams as a trusted technical advisor, leading by example by writing code, evaluating architectures, and building working proofs of concept.
  
  
Translate Intent to Architecture: Map high-level business goals from client Product Managers into technical AI specifications, ensuring the AI agents accurately understand product requirements and domain constraints.
  
  
Executive Value Articulation: Present technical architectures, security postures, and measured business outcomes to both engineering teams and C-level executives (CTO, Chief Risk Officer, CPO).
  
  
Hands on in Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), Vector Databases, Evaluation Frameworks, Prompt Engineering, Tool Calling, Function Calling, Multi-agent orchestration, AI Observability
  
  
Job responsibilities
  
  
**Must-Have Qualifications And Experience**
Experience: 15+ years of experience in software engineering, enterprise product architecture, platform engineering, or solution architecture, with at least 5+ years spent delivering high-scale products within the Financial Services or Enterprise SaaS sectors.
  
  
Technical Fluency: Deep, hands-on fluency with the modern AI stack. You must be able to build, evaluate, and debug AI development tools, agentic frameworks, and IDE-based assistants.
  
  
Domain Expertise: Thorough understanding of financial technology standards, secure SDLC, DevSecOps, data privacy laws, and enterprise architecture patterns.
  
  
**Good-to-Have Skills**
Direct experience with tools/frameworks like Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, LangChain, AutoGen, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, and vector databases.
  
  
Background in customer-facing technical roles such as Forward-Deployed Engineer, Principal Solutions Architect, or Technical Advisor.
  
  
What we offer
  
  
**Exciting Projects:**
We focus on industries like High-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them.
  
  
**Collaborative Environment:**
You Can expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment — or even abroad in one of our global centers or client facilities!
  
  
**Work-Life Balance:**
GlobalLogic prioritizes work-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules, opportunities to work from home, and paid time off and holidays.
  
  
**Professional Development:**
Our dedicated Learning & Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training(GL Vantage, Toast Master),Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings.
  
  
**Excellent Benefits:**
We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance , NPS(National Pension Scheme ), Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses.
  
  
**Fun Perks:**
We want you to love where you work, which is why we host sports events, cultural activities, offer food on subsidies rates, Corporate parties. Our vibrant offices also include dedicated GL Zones, rooftop decks and GL Club where you can drink coffee or tea with your colleagues over a game of table and offer discounts for popular stores and restaurants!
  
  
**About GlobalLogic**
GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world’s largest and most forward-thinking companies. Since 2000, we’ve been at the forefront of the digital revolution – helping create some of the most innovative and widely used digital products and experiences. Today we continue to collaborate with clients in transforming businesses and redefining industries through intelligent products, platforms, and services.

title: Manager, Data Analysis
description:
**Job Summary**
A Data Analyst interprets data and helps turn it into information that enables or improves a business process, thus affecting business decisions. Data Analysts gather information from various sources and interpret patterns and trends to make it digestible for others. They must have strong analytical skills, but above all have a burning curiosity to understand, and make sense of, data. They will work closely with:
  
  

* Data Managers, who define the team's business requirements, objectives, strategy and priorities
* Data Engineers, who design and implement the processes by which data is collected and generated
* Data Quality Analysts, who define data quality control requirements and oversee these on a day to day basis to ensure constant system health
* Upstream data teams, who provide the data that the analyst is sourcing
* Downstream Process Owners, who depend on the data to perform their business function

Data Analysts spend much of their time working with stakeholders to define data requirements, data transformation logic and supporting the delivery of these requirements from start to finish. They are experts in profiling data to understand its contents and will also have a working understanding of the business process or product that generated it in the first place. Data Analysts are the entry point to the FCC Data Team for most external stakeholders and as such will have a broad, but still detailed, understanding of all the data available and constantly seek opportunities for innovation and expansion. They are the primary liaison between up- and downstream teams
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Responsibilities for FCC Data Analysts:**

* Define clear, concise and detailed business requirements for FCC Data that clearly document the data elements and formats that are needed, outline detailed transformation expectations and list the critical data elements that will enable downstream processes to operate effectively
* Create and maintain documentation that articulates the process by which data is extracted, transformed and loaded in FCC that can be shared and understood by others
* Work with downstream FCC business process owners to constantly improve, refine and expand the datasets to improve the quality and effectiveness of those processes, as well as help them to make sense of the data, providing training where required, and derive meaningful BI / MI
* Conduct detailed analysis of upstream changes that impact FCC data – for example the introduction of a new products – to ensure that requirements remain up to date and define any new ones as necessary
* Identify areas of overlap or data gaps that can lead to increased value, either by eliminating redundant processes or expanding existing data models
* Produce accurate and insightful dashboards and reports detailing the health, content and insights available from the data, making that actionable for stakeholders and meaningful for management decision making

**Skills And Experience**
**Must-have Skills**

* SQL Querying skills
* Payments knowledge of Swift network and ISO 20022
* Banking domain knowledge

**Other Skills**

* AML knowledge
* Interpersonal skills
* Stakeholder Management

**Qualifications**
**Skills and Eligibility**

* Minimum 10+ years of professional experience as business change analyst in financial markets related banking products
* Degree (or similar) in Engineering and MBA is preferred
* A strong understanding of Cash Management systems or Payment Systems or Core Banking functionality / data flows – will be desired
* Good understanding of systems and data flows in Financial Crime Compliance / Anti Money Laundering etc. will be an added advantage
* Able to seamlessly move and translate between detailed functional data requirements and non-technical general terms
* The ability to write clear, concise and detailed business requirements that can be understood by data engineers and developers as well as business stakeholders
* Strong understanding of Cash Management systems or Payment Systems or Core Banking functionality / data flows – will be desired
* Competence with data profiling tools and methodologies (SQL at a minimum), with a preference for dedicated and sophisticated tools such as Paxata or Tableau
* Familiar with data documentation, delivery workflow and defect tracking tools – JIRA and Confluence in particular
* Demonstrated experience in handling and understanding large datasets and relational databases
* Experience in analytical roles with a large technical component, although not necessarily from a purely data perspective (e.g. they may have prior working knowledge of upstream or downstream processes that is relevant from a data perspective)
* Evidenced ability to execute and enhance a process to maintain data transformation requirements over time and constantly seek to improve these
* High quality written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to focus on multiple initiatives and data subjects (types of data or varying sources of data) at the same time
* Evidence a very strong attention to detail, reflecting the very low tolerance for error in FCC data

title: Senior Engineer, IAM with designing and architecturing AI/ML systems
description:
**Job Description**

**Senior Engineer, IAM, Chennai**

NielsenIQ is looking for an individual who can join our Identity and Access Management (IAM) Program. We are evolving our enterprise Identity and Access ecosystem by embedding AI and machine learning to improve security posture, automation, and user experience at scale. To support this effort, we are seeking a Senior AI/ML Engineer with strong experience in architecting, designing, building, and operationalizing machine learning systems in complex, distributed, and cloud-based environments.
  
  
In this role, you will lead the development of AI-driven identity, access, and security intelligence solutions, working closely with Cybersecurity, Engineering, and AI teams. You will be responsible for designing ML architectures, building production-grade pipelines, deploying models at scale, and driving measurable outcomes through applied AI for supporting out Identity Security initiative. This is a hands-on Senior Engineering role with significant technical ownership and architectural influence.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a self-driven problem solver who enjoys working at the intersection of AI/ML, Cybersecurity, Cloud platforms, and automation, and who wants to be part of growing NIQ global IAM program.

**Responsibilities:**

* Lead the design and evolution of the IAM technology stack, ensuring adherence to top-tier security practices across architecture, implementation, monitoring, maintenance, and enhancements.
* Design, build, and evolve AI/ML solutions that analyze identity, access, and behavioral data to detect anomalies, reduce risk, and automate identity security services to enforce IAM, PAM and Secrets Management controls.
* Lead the end-to-end ML lifecycle: data ingestion, feature engineering, model development, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
* Architect and implement scalable ML pipelines using Python, cloud-native services, APIs, and infrastructure-as-code.
* Partner with Cybersecurity and other Engineering teams to integrate ML models into enterprise IAM, PAM, and Secrets Management workflows and drive roadmap decisions and enterprise-scale adoption and enforcement.
* Apply advanced security engineering principles to analyze, design, develop, deploy, and support complex software solutions and infrastructure upgrades, setting standards for best practices.
* Develop and deploy real-time and batch inference services for identity and access pattern recognition.
* Apply advanced ML techniques (anomaly detection, clustering, classification, graph-based models, etc.,) to human and non-human identity use cases.
* Design model monitoring, drift detection, and performance metrics aligned to security KPIs and business outcomes.
* Leverage cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP) for distributed training, model serving, and data processing.
* Drive the adoption of MLOps best practices, including CI/CD for models, versioning, reproducibility, and observability.
* Collaborate with product owners and stakeholders to translate security problems into well-defined ML use cases.
* Communicate technical concepts, trade-offs, and results clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Mentor junior engineers and help establish Cybersecurity engineering standards for applied AI across the organization.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer science, Computer Information Systems, Data Science, or a related field (Master’s preferred).
* 7+ years of software engineering experience, with 4+ years focused on architecting and designing AI/ML systems at global scale (Cybersecurity preferred).
* Strong proficiency in Python and experience building ML systems using modern frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn).
* Hands-on experience with data pipelines, APIs, and distributed systems.
* Broad knowledge of IAM capabilities, identity stores, authentication/authorization, strong authentication, privileged access methodologies, and Zero Trust principles
* Experience deploying and operating ML models in cloud environments (Azure, AWS, GCP).
* Practical knowledge of MLOps practices, including model versioning, CI/CD, monitoring, and automation.
* Experience working with identity, security, or behavioral data (IAM, access logs, telemetry, or similar domains).
* Familiarity with REST APIs, Git-based workflows, containerization, and infrastructure-as-code.
* Understanding of non-human identities, service accounts, secrets, and automation-driven access patterns is a strong plus.
* Ability to design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, explainability, and operational reliability.
* Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills in ambiguous, real-world environments.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional teams.
* Proven ability to work independently while driving complex initiatives across large organizations.
* Ability to effectively prioritize and execute tasks in a fast-paced environment, balancing risk reduction with business objectives.
* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, capable of translating complex technical concepts into clear, actionable insights for diverse stakeholders.
* Strong ability to work autonomously while influencing cross-functional teams and have proven track record of driving adoption of security best practices across large organizations.

**Our Benefits**

* Flexible working environment
* Volunteer time off
* LinkedIn Learning
* Employee-Assistance-Program (EAP)

title: Databricks AI Architect
description:
**Requirements**
The ideal candidate is a hands-on AI architect with deep Databricks and GenAI expertise, strong data engineering foundations, and a proven record of taking AI solutions to production at enterprise scale. Key requirements:
  
  

* 12–14 years of experience in data and AI/ML solutions, including designing and architecting large-scale (TB/PB) data platforms and production AI/ML systems.
* Deep, hands-on architecture expertise with Databricks — Spark/PySpark, Delta Lake, lakehouse/medallion architecture, Unity Catalog, Databricks Workflows, and Delta Live Tables — with strong performance and cost optimization.
* Proven experience architecting Generative AI / LLM solutions — RAG pipelines, chunking and embedding strategies, vector store design, prompt engineering, evaluation, and guardrails/responsible-AI patterns.
* Strong hands-on experience with native Databricks AI capabilities — Mosaic AI (Model Serving, Vector Search, Agent Framework), Foundation Model APIs, MLflow, Feature Store, and model governance via Unity Catalog.
* Solid ML/MLOps foundations — model lifecycle management, experiment tracking, deployment, monitoring, and drift/quality evaluation in production.
* Expert-level PySpark and Spark SQL, with strong Python for building reusable data and feature pipelines that power AI workloads (batch and streaming).
* Strong hands-on experience with AWS and Azure Cloud, including networking, IAM/security, cost optimization, and AI/ML services; comfortable architecting across cloud data and AI services.
* Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain/LangGraph or equivalent), agentic patterns, tool use, and multi-agent workflows at an architecture level.
* Deep expertise in data and AI governance, data quality, lineage, security, and responsible AI — including PII handling, access control (Unity Catalog, RBAC), and audit.
* Proven ability to set architecture standards, lead design reviews, and provide technical leadership and mentorship across multiple engineering and data science teams.
* Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills; able to drive architecture decisions and translate business needs into technical blueprints for both technical and executive audiences.

Good to Have: Knowledge of LLMOps and observability tooling for AI systems; Databricks / cloud / AI certifications; experience leading cloud/data platform migration and modernization to Databricks; experience contributing to POCs, proposals, and RFPs.
  
  
Databricks, AI
  
  
AI & GenAI Architecture
  
  

* Own the end-to-end architecture for AI/ML and GenAI solutions on Databricks — data and feature pipelines, model training/serving, RAG, and agentic applications.
* Design RAG and LLM architectures — retrieval and embedding pipelines, vector store design, prompt/evaluation strategy, and guardrails — using Mosaic AI and Foundation Model APIs.
* Define reference architectures, design patterns, and reusable frameworks for scalable, secure, and cost-optimized AI platforms.

Data & Platform Foundation
  
  

* Architect the lakehouse foundation (Delta Lake, medallion, Unity Catalog) and reusable PySpark pipelines that feed AI and analytics workloads.
* Guide implementation using Databricks Workflows and Delta Live Tables, with standards for data quality, incremental loads, and schema evolution.

MLOps, Governance & Reliability
  
  

* Define MLOps/LLMOps practices — model lifecycle, MLflow tracking, deployment, monitoring, and drift/quality evaluation in production.
* Establish AI and data governance, cataloging, lineage, access control, and responsible-AI standards (PII handling, guardrails, audit) ensuring security and compliance.
* Define observability, monitoring, and cost-governance practices for reliable and efficient AI systems at scale.

Technical Leadership & Collaboration
  
  

* Set and enforce architecture standards and best practices; lead design and code reviews across multiple engineering and data science teams.
* Mentor engineers, ML engineers, and leads, and provide hands-on guidance from prototype to production readiness.
* Collaborate with product owners, engineering leaders, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into AI blueprints, POCs, and roadmaps.

description:

* Agile Delivery: Experience working in Agile environments for software and product development.
* Communication: Exceptional storytelling and executive presentation skills with the ability to articulate technical AI concepts in clear business terms.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations research, Computer Science, Data Analytics, Information Technology, or a related discipline; Master's degree preferred.
* 8–12 years of progressive experience in Supply Chain, Material Planning and Logistics areas.
* Demonstrated experience delivering AI, analytics, automation, or digital transformation initiatives in a manufacturing or automotive environment.
* Proven track record of taking AI/ML or advanced analytics projects from concept to production with measurable business impact

**Preferred Certifications (Plus)**

* Certified in Production and Inventory Management or Certified Supply Chain Professional.
* Project Management Professional (PMP).
* Lean Six Sigma Green/Black Belt certification.
* AI/Data Science professional certifications (e.g., Azure AI Engineer, AWS Machine Learning Specialty).

title: Specialist, Software Technology
description:
**Company Overview**
 KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice\-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and we invest 15% of sales back into R\&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem\-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us.
   

  

**Group/Division**
 With over 40 years of semiconductor process control experience, chipmakers around the globe rely on KLA to ensure that their fabs ramp next\-generation devices to volume production quickly and cost\-effectively. Enabling the movement towards advanced chip design, KLA's Global Products Group (GPG), which is responsible for creating all of KLA’s metrology and inspection products, is looking for the best and the brightest research scientist, software engineers, application development engineers, and senior product technology process engineers. First to deliver the best imaging and classification data for every defect or point on any layer at any time. EBeam’s mission encapsulates its role as the “eyes” of KLA’s product line, providing timely information on defects and critical locations on the wafer at the highest spatial resolution possible. Customers use EBeam products alongside KLA patterned and bare wafer inspectors to quickly understand the nature of defects and other imperfections on product wafers and take action to correct the manufacturing process.
   

  

**Job Description/Preferred Qualifications**
**Must have Qualifications:**
* Deep proficiency in core programming concepts, with hands\-on expertise in Java, Python, or C\+\+
* Strong background in object\-oriented design (OOD) and multi\-threaded application development
* Demonstrated experience in full\-stack web development, specializing in microservices architecture, performance optimization, and security best practices
* Solid understanding of data structures and algorithms
* Practical experience with Kubernetes and designing scalable microservices
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and organizational skills, with strong communication abilities (both verbal and written)
* Ability to bridge theoretical concepts and real\-world implementations
* Experience managing the full product development lifecycle, from concept to deployment
* Experience designing and deploying ML/DL pipelines for training, inference, validation, and monitoring is a plus
* Technical leadership or mentoring experience is a plus
* Exposure to computer vision, signal processing, or time‑series analysis, particularly for high‑volume or high‑resolution data is a plus


**Responsibilities:**
* Design, develop, and maintain ML/DL‑based software solutions \& big\-data analysis for large, complex semiconductor systems
* Apply machine learning and deep learning techniques to semiconductor metrology, inspection, yield analysis, defect classification, and process optimization
* Collaborate with globally distributed teams, including hardware, optics, algorithms, and systems engineers, to deliver high‑impact AI solutions
* Analyze and resolve complex system‑level issues spanning software, ML models, data quality, and hardware interactions
* Drive model performance tuning, robustness, and explainability to meet manufacturing and customer requirements
* Identify root causes of product or process variability and propose innovative ML‑driven solutions
* Support technology transfer from research and prototyping to high‑volume manufacturing environments
* Travel to other company sites and customer locations as required to support deployment, debugging, and adoption
* Participate in end‑to‑end product development lifecycle activities, from design through deployment and support


**Minimum Qualifications**
 Doctorate (Academic) Degree and related work experience of 3 years; Master's Level Degree and related work experience of 6 years; Bachelor's Level Degree and related work experience of 8 years
   

  

*We offer a competitive, family friendly total rewards package. We design our programs to reflect our commitment to an inclusive environment, while ensuring we provide benefits that meet the diverse needs of our employees.*
*KLA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer*
 Be aware of potentially fraudulent job postings or suspicious recruiting activity by persons that are currently posing as KLA employees. KLA never asks for any financial compensation to be considered for an interview, to become an employee, or for equipment. As you grow, we expect you to move beyond using GenAI to building with it \- designing agent workflows, contributing reusable skills, and helping Securin compound its Proactive Exposure Management expertise faster than any competitor can replicate.
 



  




* Demonstrated ability to use GenAI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, etc.) for daily work \- drafting, research, summarization, data analysis, code generation, or workflow automation as relevant to the Pro.

* Comfort with agentic AI workflows \- using, designing, or building multi\-step AI agents that execute tasks autonomously with human\-in\-the\-loop validation
* Awareness of AI security fundamentals \- prompt injection risks, data classification rules, sandboxed execution, and responsible handling of sensitive data in AI workflows
* Familiarity with connecting GenAI tools to internal data sources, APIs, and enterprise systems
* Ability to contribute reusable AI skills, templates, agent configurations, or automation workflows to a shared repository for team\-wide use
* Willingness to learn and adopt new AI tools as they evolve; participation in AI adoption sprints, hackathons, and knowledge\-sharing within the team



  





 If you meet the above requirements and are passionate about cybersecurity and providing excellent customer service, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity.
 



  





**Why should we connect?** 




 We are a bunch of passionate cybersecurity professionals who are building a culture of security. Today, cybersecurity is no more a luxury but a necessity with a global market value of $150 billion.
 



  





 At Securin, we live by a people\-first approach. We firmly believe that our employees should enjoy what they do. For our employees, we provide a hybrid work environment with competitive best\-in\-industry pay, while providing them with an environment to learn, thrive, and grow. Our hybrid working environment allows employees to work from the comfort of their homes or the office if they choose to. For the right candidate, this will feel like your second home.
 



  





 If you are passionate about cybersecurity just as we are, we would love to connect and share ideas.

 Skills and attributes for a successful career at EY require a learning mindset and passion to add value to GDS, member firms and client organisations. **To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Qualified or Part/ nearly Qualified Actuary with at least 8\+ years to 15 years of experience in Life Insurance industry, either within a consulting firm or an Insurer or an organisation providing Insurance services (such as reserving, IFRS17 or LDTI)
* Ability to multi\-task and flexible work attitude packed with good analytical skills
* Experience of handling a moderate sized team will be an advantage
* Proficiency in MS\-Office Suite, Power BI, VBA, SAS, R Programming, Python, SQL, SPSS, etc., will be a plus


**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* The ability to build relationships with colleagues across the business, support them and promote a collaborative environment
* Overseas exposure (especially US/Canada/Europe/UK/Australia market experience)


**What We Look For**
* Deep knowledge and experience of the insurance industry and/or consulting. Relevant recent big 4 experience in leading actuarial engagement with recognised insurers will be an advantage. This ideally should be complemented by employment experience within the Insurance sector either at an insurer, intermediary or regulator
* Up to date knowledge of the regulatory environment impacting insurers and other financial service organisations
* Experience of supporting teams to high quality timely delivery, actively building relationships and promoting a collaborative culture when working with colleagues
